scope: Selected entry points into immutable complete archives; not an exhaustive listing of every case. Paths are exact, without shell glob syntax. No new physical measurements.

groups.title: FP32 versus FP64 bulk inference
groups.scope: RTX 5090; same fixed hour input and nuisance model. Inference timing, not complete acquisition or calibrated admission.

groups.title: FP64 reduction organizations and cached covariance preparation
groups.scope: Both reduction organizations retain FP64; not a precision-necessity comparison. Gaussian design prep cost and reuse are separate from inference.

groups.title: Exact fixed hour input payloads
groups.scope: Existing exported input bytes; does not cover every later raw physical holdout or day input.

groups.title: Original optimization source and tests
groups.scope: Historical source snapshot, not current-code test execution.

groups.scope: Plain BF16/TF32/scaled FP16 failed development likelihood gates; more accurate multi-component modes are still experimental.

groups.title: Native dense tensor instructions, profile and counter denial
groups.scope: PTX/SASS and event traces; hardware utilization counters unavailable. FP64 partial-reduction share is kernel-time only.

groups.title: Long accumulation and signal-absent interference
groups.scope: Actual sampled two-day and interference diagnostics; null interference crosses reference gates. Raw physical IQ must be regenerated.

groups.title: Tensor source and recorded CPU checks
groups.scope: Logs establish the stated historical runs; test source is not a new run.

groups.title: Native floating FP4 and counter limits
groups.scope: Blackwell native dense product evidence. Synthetic GEMM speedup does not establish receiver efficiency.

groups.title: Separate sampled template and observation quantization
groups.scope: Actual sampled converter/interference diagnostics; nonlinear quantization is not replaced by Gaussian projected noise.

groups.title: FP4 independent holdout, complete workspace and hardware comparisons
groups.scope: 753 physical cases and paired policies; zero-event samples do not qualify operational tails. Fixed workspace and broad correlation-only workload are distinct.

groups.title: FP4 source, exporter and holdout regeneration
groups.scope: Raw holdout arrays omitted; frozen generator, exporter, seeds and hashes support regeneration. Follow recorded binary/library prerequisites.

groups.title: Consumer GPU final tests and original failures
groups.scope: RTX 4090 final suites: tensor14, correlation15, workspace8. CPU provenance14. Earlier failures remain, not silently counted as passes.

groups.title: Subnormal scaling and FP8 conversion
groups.scope: Observed arithmetic/conversion defects and repairs; not a receiver sensitivity certificate.

groups.title: Short tensor partials and higher-precision outer sums
groups.scope: Represented-input synthetic arithmetic tests distinguish FP8 input loss from accumulation loss.

groups.title: Independent consumer holdout and initial setup failures
groups.scope: 128 physical sampled inputs, 1024 paired policy evaluations; zero of 32 null admissions is inadequate for operational tail claims.

groups.title: Consumer profiling and measurement limits
groups.scope: Kernel event shares and CPU traces, not hardware SM/tensor/DRAM counters.

groups.title: Sustained complete receiver replay and failed batching benefit
groups.scope: One fixed capture repeated; cloned B8 columns are not independent trials. Full-call latency and amortized service time differ.

groups.title: Packing-inclusive products, tile sweep and setup failure
groups.scope: Synthetic shape-specific timings with sampled-output gate, not full receiver admission.

groups.title: Template-only versus observation-only numerical diagnostics
groups.scope: Development sampled waveform; CPU FP64 products separate input representation from arithmetic. No independent reception qualification.

groups.title: Consumer exact source and input regeneration
groups.scope: Archived exporter and source snapshot; development raw IQ present; 128 holdout raw IQ omitted. Manifest binds every payload.
